holdTheLeftMouse: Hold the left mouse button to steer
aRibbonOfLight: A ribbon of light has formed around your target, and the alien is tethered to it. Fly into the bright ring to start it. {steer}.
weaveThroughTheGlowing: Weave through the glowing crests in order, then reach the gold star at the end. Stay on the line: if it flickers red you are drifting off, and it breaks if you stay off.
noProblemKeepFiring: No problem: keep firing at an alien and a new flow appears in a few seconds. Fly into its ring and stay on the line this time.
theAlienIsStunned: The alien is stunned for a moment, with its back turned. Fly into the gold cone behind it: every laser shot fired from inside the cone is a CRITICAL hit.
thatIsTheFlow: That is the Flow Strike: follow the flow, stun, strike from behind. The same alien cannot be stunned again for a while, and bosses only stagger: they stay put but keep attacking.
nextTimeSlideInto: Next time, slide into the gold cone behind the alien right after the stun: shots from there are critical. A new flow appears as you keep fighting.
